title: The Harbour Shop

intro.speaker: mara
intro.text: Here's a little purse of coins. Would you please buy a few things from the harbour shop for me?

intro.speaker: mara
intro.text: Count your coins carefully. And check your change!

steps.speaker: mara

feedback.all_good: Just right! You'd make a fine ship's purser.

journal_line: I bought things at the harbour shop for Captain Mara.
